## Appearance

## Personality

Tabby possesses a preference for smaller living spaces, disliking large dwellings. Her primary ambition is to see the Sphinx at least once before she dies.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008), [v3 ch.Dawn P3](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0003)_

## History

Tabby Linden inherited her house and property from her brother [Aaron](../character/aaron.md), after which it became known as Tabby's Place. She later agreed, alongside her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md), to rent the property's cottage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

## Quotes

> "Their age exceeds one hundred years, and their positions on both flanks of this hearth have remained unchanged from the time my brother Aaron fetched them from London half a century back. My brother Aaron was the namesake for Linden Avenue."
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)

> "They are named Gog and Magog. Gog’s gaze goes toward the right, whereas Magog’s goes toward the left. Furthermore, I have a final query. It isn't a problem for you, I trust, if this house goes by the name of Tabby’s Place?"
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "Provided you pledge to take great care of the dogs, I am going to leave them in their current spots,"
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "It was my intention to remove that sign today."
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004)

> "Now, prior to treating our agreement as finalized, would you care to tour the residence and inspect everything?"
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)

### [Maria](../character/maria.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--tabby.md)

[Maria](../character/maria.md) is Tabby's niece who serves as her friend, comrade, and traveling companion. The two stay overseas together and make plans to go to Egypt. They also jointly manage their property, Tabby's Place, successfully arranging to rent out their cottage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), +2 more_
